tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search the notavibe catalog of open-source projects. The query matches project name, project description, and the category, ecosystem, kind, runtime, license_family and capabilities vocabulary facets; free-form repository topics are not matched. capabilities names what a project does, such as http-c

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Return the public profile of one catalog project, identified by host and either an owner/repo slug or a numeric repository id. Both host and one of slug or id are required; a call missing them is refused as an invalid argument and names what is missing. A well-formed lookup that matches no project i

tools.name: compare_projects
tools.description: Return the public profiles of two catalog projects side by side, identified by host and two owner/repo slugs. The response presents each project's facts and health bands; it draws no conclusion and names no winner. The pair is refused when either project is unavailable or has insufficient measured s

tools.description: List the public curated lists in the notavibe catalog, or return the public members of one list identified by owner handle and list slug. tools.name: get_more_tools
tools.description: Records a description of a capability missing from the other tools of this server, for the maintainers of this server. The description is stored by an analytics service. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_projects" is 3352 chars, far longer than this server's median (344). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
